description: yass: three one-line shell hooks, no scripts. After a compaction, and at most every check_every_min minutes of tool activity (the pulse), they start the seat-check agent in the background (claude -p). PostToolUse shows each session one short status line after a switch, hands the main thread a one-time note while a switch waits for subagents to wind down, and SubagentStop starts the switch once little subagent context is alive or the deadline passed. Each exits in milliseconds when there is nothing to do; all do nothing until onboarding wrote ~/.yass/policy.md, in sessions that use a token from the environment, or inside a check.

hooks.command: D="$HOME/.yass"; [ -z "$YASS_CHILD" ] && [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/policy.md" ] && [ "$(jq -r .auto "$D/config.json" 2>/dev/null)" != false ] || exit 0; L() { (cd "$D" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID YASS_CHILD=1 nohup "${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude}" -p "$1" --agent yass:seat-check --model "$(jq -r '.model // "sonnet"' "$D/config.json")" --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools=Bash,Read,Write,Edit --no-session-persistence --settings '{"language":"English"}' >> "$D/check.log" 2>&1 &); }; [ -z "$(find "$D/last-check" -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; touch "$D/last-check"; L 'Seat check. Trigger: compact.'; exit 0

D="$HOME/.yass"; [ -z "$YASS_CHILD" ] && [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/policy.md" ] && [ "$(jq -r .auto "$D/config.json" 2>/dev/null)" != false ] || exit 0; L() { (cd "$D" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID YASS_CHILD=1 nohup "${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude}" -p "$1" --agent yass:seat-check --model "$(jq -r '.model // "sonnet"' "$D/config.json")" --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools=Bash,Read,Write,Edit --no-session-persistence --settings '{"language":"English"}' >> "$D/check.log" 2>&1 &); }; I=$(cat); if [ -f "$D/pending.json" ] && [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.after // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] && { [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.deadline // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] || [ "$(find "$HOME/.claude/projects" -path '*/subagents/*' -name '*.jsonl' -mmin -2 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do tail -n 40 "$f" | jq -s '[.[] | .message.usage? // empty | (.input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0)] | last // 0'; done | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}')" -le "$(jq -r '.max_live_context // 150000' "$D/pending.json")" ]; }; then mkdir -p "$D/run"; mv "$D/pending.json" "$D/run/pending.taken" 2>/dev/null && { jq -n -c --argjson now "$(date +%s)" --argjson p "$(jq .id "$D/run/pending.taken")" '{id: $now, plan: $p, resume: true, text: "yass: the seat switch is starting now. If you were holding back subagents, start them; otherwise carry on as before."}' > "$D/notice.json"; L "Switch to $(jq -r .target "$D/run/pending.taken"). Reason: $(jq -r .reason "$D/run/pending.taken"). Planned switch; its deadline passed or the live subagents wound down."; }; elif [ -z "$(find "$D/last-check" -mmin -"$(jq -r '.check_every_min // 30' "$D/config.json")" 2>/dev/null)" ] || { [ -f "$D/next-check" ] && [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(cat "$D/next-check")" ] 2>/dev/null; }; then rm -f "$D/next-check"; touch "$D/last-check"; L 'Seat check. Trigger: pulse.'; fi; [ -n "$(find "$D" -maxdepth 1 \( -name notice.json -mmin -30 -o -name switched.json -mmin -60 \) 2>/dev/null)" ] && [ -z "$(printf %s "$I" | jq -r '.agent_id // empty')" ] || exit 0; S=$(printf %s "$I" | jq -r .session_id); N=; M=; mkdir -p "$D/run"; if [ -n "$(find "$D/notice.json" -mmin -30 2>/dev/null)" ]; then K="$D/run/noted-$S-$(jq -r .id "$D/notice.json")"; [ -f "$K" ] || { touch "$K"; N="$D/notice.json"; }; fi; if [ -n "$(find "$D/switched.json" -mmin -60 2>/dev/null)" ]; then K="$D/run/noted-$S-sw$(jq -r .id "$D/switched.json")"; [ -f "$K" ] || { touch "$K"; M="$D/switched.json"; }; fi; [ -n "$N$M" ] || exit 0; jq -n -c --argjson n "$([ -n "$N" ] && cat "$N" || echo null)" --argjson m "$([ -n "$M" ] && cat "$M" || echo null)" '(if $m then {systemMessage: $m.msg} else {} end) + (if $n then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $n.text}} else {} end)'; exit 0

D="$HOME/.yass"; [ -z "$YASS_CHILD" ] && [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/policy.md" ] && [ "$(jq -r .auto "$D/config.json" 2>/dev/null)" != false ] || exit 0; L() { (cd "$D" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID YASS_CHILD=1 nohup "${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude}" -p "$1" --agent yass:seat-check --model "$(jq -r '.model // "sonnet"' "$D/config.json")" --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools=Bash,Read,Write,Edit --no-session-persistence --settings '{"language":"English"}' >> "$D/check.log" 2>&1 &); }; [ -f "$D/pending.json" ] || exit 0; A=$(jq -r '.agent_id // empty'); A=${A:-none}; [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.after // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] || exit 0; LIVE=$(find "$HOME/.claude/projects" -path '*/subagents/*' -name '*.jsonl' -mmin -2 ! -name "*$A*" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do tail -n 40 "$f" | jq -s '[.[] | .message.usage? // empty | (.input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0)] | last // 0'; done | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'); [ "$LIVE" -le "$(jq -r '.max_live_context // 150000' "$D/pending.json")" ] || [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.deadline // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] || exit 0; mkdir -p "$D/run"; mv "$D/pending.json" "$D/run/pending.taken" 2>/dev/null && { jq -n -c --argjson now "$(date +%s)" --argjson p "$(jq .id "$D/run/pending.taken")" '{id: $now, plan: $p, resume: true, text: "yass: the seat switch is starting now. If you were holding back subagents, start them; otherwise carry on as before."}' > "$D/notice.json"; L "Switch to $(jq -r .target "$D/run/pending.taken"). Reason: $(jq -r .reason "$D/run/pending.taken"). Planned switch; live subagent context now $LIVE tokens."; }; exit 0

D="$HOME/.yass"; [ -z "$YASS_CHILD" ] && [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/policy.md" ] && [ -n "$(find "$D/notice.json" -mmin -60 2>/dev/null)" ] && [ "$(jq -r .auto "$D/config.json" 2>/dev/null)" != false ] || exit 0; L() { (cd "$D" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID YASS_CHILD=1 nohup "${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude}" -p "$1" --agent yass:seat-check --model "$(jq -r '.model // "sonnet"' "$D/config.json")" --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools=Bash,Read,Write,Edit --no-session-persistence --settings '{"language":"English"}' >> "$D/check.log" 2>&1 &); }; S=$(jq -r .session_id); P=$(jq -r 'if .wait_until then .id elif .resume then (.plan // empty) else empty end' "$D/notice.json"); [ -n "$P" ] && [ -f "$D/run/noted-$S-$P" ] || exit 0; for i in $(seq 1 180); do if [ "$(jq -r '.resume // false' "$D/notice.json")" = true ]; then K="$D/run/noted-$S-$(jq -r .id "$D/notice.json")"; [ -f "$K" ] && exit 0; touch "$K"; jq -r .text "$D/notice.json" >&2; exit 2; fi; if [ -f "$D/pending.json" ] && [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.after // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] && { [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.deadline // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] || [ -z "$(find "$HOME/.claude/projects" -path '*/subagents/*' -name '*.jsonl' -mmin -2 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ]; }; then mkdir -p "$D/run"; mv "$D/pending.json" "$D/run/pending.taken" 2>/dev/null && { jq -n -c --argjson now "$(date +%s)" --argjson p "$(jq .id "$D/run/pending.taken")" '{id: $now, plan: $p, resume: true, text: "yass: the seat switch is starting now. If you were holding back subagents, start them; otherwise carry on as before."}' > "$D/notice.json"; L "Switch to $(jq -r .target "$D/run/pending.taken"). Reason: $(jq -r .reason "$D/run/pending.taken"). Planned switch; a session went idle, and its deadline passed or no subagents are running."; }; fi; [ -f "$D/pending.json" ] || [ -f "$D/run/pending.taken" ] || exit 0; sleep 10; done; exit 0
